notes: I cannot is the fused unit rule 35 prescribes where yākōl stands beside the negative, target-headed on cannot; the source head on the verb rather than the negative is named as the contested point.
The ʾet before pî YHWH stays unrepresented because beyond carries ʿābar's own crossing sense and is rule 44's particle, not a word spent on the object relation under rule 16's first family.
